The brand blends strategic consulting expertise with hands-on digital execution.

### Contact form
- URL: https://example.com/contact
- Endpoint: https://example.com/api/email/contact-form
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Fields:
  - `name` (text, required)
  - `email` (email, required)
  - `phone` (tel)
  - `message` (textarea, required)
  - `privacy_consent` (checkbox, required)

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About דרור ברק
A business consultant specializing in sales and marketing for the online courses and academy industry. Works with both large established colleges and new course creators just starting out. The key differentiator is highly personalized, close-knit client guidance combined with a full 360-degree digital agency umbrella — offering an end-to-end solution under one roof. The brand blends strategic consulting expertise with hands-on digital execution.

## Target Audience
- בעלי מכללות וקורסים - הן לקוחות גדולים והן קורסים בתחילת הדרך
- בעלי מכללות וקורסים
- סוכנויות שיווק דיגיטלי
- מורים לקורסים מקוונים

## Industry
Business Consulting / Digital Marketing
